Any Egypt slice containing neom-sindalah-ksa routes is a scope/filter defect and must not be promoted as Egypt geography.

lane_conclusion: One exact Hong Kong route-level annual passenger total was found but is historical benchmark only. Taiwan route rn-5085d4e1f498 has current operator endpoint-name/address evidence but no current local DiDi proof, so its quarantine and 95,705 demand hold remain. Egypt’s three cruise-terminal names are current; Ministry port coordinates are not berth coordinates and remain held. All Cairo river-bus and Giftun/Mahmeya exact coordinates stay hard null. Hurghada proof must not inherit to El Gouna, and NEOM is Saudi Arabia, never Egypt.
